import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

W = 24
PROJ = 12
HID = 16
NIN = 12


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.c0 = nn.Conv2d(NIN, W, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.colmix = nn.Conv2d(W, W, 1)
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(W, PROJ, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * PROJ, HID, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(HID, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * W, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        b = obs[:, 0:Z]
        t = obs[:, Z:2 * Z]
        m = obs[:, 2 * Z:3 * Z]
        e = obs[:, 3 * Z:4 * Z]

        def below(v):
            return F.pad(v, (0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0))[:, :Z]

        def above(v):
            return F.pad(v, (0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1))[:, 1:]

        per = torch.stack([b, t, m, e, below(b), below(t), above(b), above(t)], dim=2)
        ext = obs[:, 4 * Z:4 * Z + 3].unsqueeze(1).expand(B, Z, 3, Y, X)
        lvl = (torch.arange(Z, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype) / Z).view(1, Z, 1, 1, 1).expand(B, Z, 1, Y, X)
        x = torch.cat([per, ext, lvl], dim=2).reshape(B * Z, NIN, Y, X)

        h = F.relu(self.c0(x))
        h = F.relu(self.c1(h))
        f = F.relu(h + self.c2(h))
        fz = f.view(B, Z, W, Y, X)
        cm = self.colmix(fz.amax(1)).unsqueeze(1)
        fz = F.relu(fz + cm)
        f = fz.reshape(B * Z, W, Y, X)

        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            hh = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(hh))
        s = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        T = s.shape[1]
        s = s.view(B, Z, T, Y, X)
        place = torch.logsumexp(s, dim=1).flatten(1)

        g = self.glob(torch.cat([fz.mean((1, 3, 4)), fz.amax(4).amax(3).amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.005}

HID = 96
K = 8
CTX = 32
CP = 8
MH = 32


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.Z = int(spec.Z)
        Z = self.Z
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in spec.footprints]
        self.col1 = nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, HID, 1)
        self.col2 = nn.Conv2d(HID, HID, 1)
        self.lay = nn.Conv2d(HID, Z * K, 1)
        self.ctx_in = nn.Conv2d(HID, CTX, 1)
        self.ctx_conv = nn.Conv2d(CTX, CTX, 3, padding=1)
        self.ctx_proj = nn.Conv2d(CTX, CP, 1)
        self.zemb = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(Z, MH))
        self.mix1 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(3 * K, MH) for _ in self.fps])
        self.cmix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(2 * CP, MH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.mix2 = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(MH, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * CTX + 2 * Z * K, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        Z = self.Z
        h = F.relu(self.col1(obs))
        h = F.relu(self.col2(h))
        a = self.lay(h)
        c = F.relu(self.ctx_in(h))
        c = F.relu(c + self.ctx_conv(c))
        cp = self.ctx_proj(c)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), m1, cm, m2 in zip(self.fps, self.mix1, self.cmix, self.mix2):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = a, a, a
                cmx, cav = cp, cp
            else:
                q = F.pad(a, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                qc = F.pad(cp, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                cmx = F.max_pool2d(qc, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                cav = F.avg_pool2d(qc, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            pl = torch.cat([mx.reshape(B, Z, K, Y, X), mn.reshape(B, Z, K, Y, X), av.reshape(B, Z, K, Y, X)], dim=2)
            pl = pl.permute(0, 3, 4, 1, 2)
            cb = cm(torch.cat([cmx, cav], dim=1)).permute(0, 2, 3, 1).unsqueeze(3)
            hz = F.relu(m1(pl) + cb + self.zemb)
            s = m2(hz).squeeze(-1)
            res.append(torch.logsumexp(s, dim=-1).reshape(B, Y * X))
        place = torch.cat(res, dim=1)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([c.mean((2, 3)), c.amax((2, 3)), a.mean((2, 3)), a.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

def dihedral(obs):
    B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
    vs = [obs, obs.flip(2), obs.flip(3), obs.flip(2).flip(3)]
    if Y == X:
        t = obs.transpose(2, 3)
        vs = vs + [t, t.flip(2), t.flip(3), t.flip(2).flip(3)]
    return torch.cat(vs, dim=1)

    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 2, "gamma": 0.99, "gae_lambda": 0.95, "ent_coef": 0.01}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
GC = 8
GH = 256


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        Y = int(spec.Y)
        X = int(spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.gproj = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, GC, 1)
        self.gmlp = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(GC * Y * X, GH), nn.ReLU(), nn.Linear(GH, int(spec.n_place)))
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        gp = F.relu(self.gproj(f)).flatten(1)
        place = place + self.gmlp(gp)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 64, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 8, "ppo_epochs": 1, "gamma": 0.95, "gae_lambda": 0.9, "ent_coef": 0.005}

D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
LAYERS = 2
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, h, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.h = h
        self.n1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.o = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.n2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.f1 = nn.Linear(d, ff)
        self.f2 = nn.Linear(ff, d)

    def forward(self, x):
        B, N, Dm = x.shape
        hd = Dm // self.h
        qkv = self.qkv(self.n1(x)).view(B, N, 3, self.h, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q = qkv[0]
        k = qkv[1]
        v = qkv[2]
        a = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        y = torch.matmul(a, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, N, Dm)
        x = x + self.o(y)
        x = x + self.f2(F.relu(self.f1(self.n2(x))))
        return x


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        n = int(spec.Y) * int(spec.X)
        self.inp1 = nn.Linear(int(spec.in_channels), D)
        self.inp2 = nn.Linear(D, D)
        self.pos = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(1, n, D) * 0.02)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(LAYERS)])
        self.nf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B, C, Y, X = obs.shape
        t = obs.permute(0, 2, 3, 1).reshape(B, Y * X, C)
        x = F.relu(self.inp1(t))
        x = self.inp2(x) + self.pos
        for blk in self.blocks:
            x = blk(x)
        x = F.relu(self.nf(x))
        f = x.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([x.mean(1), x.amax(1)], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.001, "n_envs": 128, "rollout_len": 16, "n_minibatches": 16, "ppo_epochs": 1, "gamma": 0.9, "gae_lambda": 0.9, "ent_coef": 0.005}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
CW = 32


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Critic(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cin):
        super().__init__()
        self.c0 = nn.Conv2d(cin, CW, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(CW, CW, 3, padding=1)
        self.fc = nn.Linear(2 * CW, 64)
        self.out = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs):
        h = F.relu(self.c0(obs))
        h = F.relu(h + self.c1(h))
        g = F.relu(self.fc(torch.cat([h.mean((2, 3)), h.amax((2, 3))], dim=1)))
        return self.out(g).squeeze(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.critic = Critic(int(spec.in_channels))

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(obs)
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.critic(obs)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: There are no trial results yet, and the starting architecture scored 0.000 on both seeds. With the default recipe it gets only about 32 PPO updates of 4,096 steps each, which is likely too few for a 257-way action policy. To be exact, a build needs about 10 correct placements in a row plus a well-timed DONE. That means both the training recipe and per-placement accuracy could be the bottleneck. A good placement depends on where the brick lands: the highest build level under its footprint must match target cells that are still missing at that level. The baseline mixes all layers together in a 1x1 stem. A trunk that treats each layer separately, with shared weights, might learn that per-layer match more easily. This round separates the two causes. Candidate A changes only the recipe (more updates, fewer epochs, longer horizon). Candidate C pushes the recipe further. Candidate B adds a per-layer architecture on top of A's recipe.
analyses.2: All three trials scored 0 on both dev and training. Changing how samples trade off against epochs (r1c1 against r1c3) made no difference, so the recipe alone is not the bottleneck. A placement is correct when every column under the brick has its lowest missing cell at the same layer, L, and at least one of those columns is already built up to L. The starting head can represent this rule in principle, so learning it is the likely problem, not capacity. A second suspect is getting stuck on early DONE: most early placements earn negative reward, so the agent may learn that stopping is safest, which gives zero exact builds. This round runs a small 2x2 test. A layer-factored head shares one per-layer scorer across all layers. An anti-collapse change starts the DONE bias at -2 and raises entropy to 0.02. A and C share one architecture with and without the anti-collapse change; B and C compare the two architectures with it applied.
analyses.3: All six trials scored exactly 0 on dev and on training success, whichever architecture or recipe was used: 1 or 2 epochs, 230k–410k steps, a layer-factored head, or a low starting DONE bias with more entropy. The architectures were built on different ideas, so zero training success in every one is suspicious. A plausible cause is that this world's coordinate or action conventions differ from the description, for example transposed or flipped axes, or a different anchor. If so, every translation-equivariant head anchored at the top-left cell would fail no matter how it is tuned. This round tests that directly. One candidate feeds the trunk flipped and transposed copies of the observation. Another adds a learned global mapping from cells to actions alongside the conv head. The third is a pure MLP with no spatial assumptions. Any result above zero should guide the last round.
analyses.4: All 9 trials scored exactly 0, both on dev and in training. The changes behind them were: more updates (32 to 208), 1 or 2 PPO epochs, gamma 0.99, a DONE-bias prior with more entropy, a dihedral input, a global action map, a pure MLP, and layer-factored heads. The zeros persisted even in designs that make no assumptions about how actions or observations are laid out (pure MLP, global map). So a mismatch in action or observation alignment probably isn't the main cause. More likely the agent never learns to build at all: weak learning signal, critic loss crowding out the shared features, or too few useful updates. There is no gradient to follow between trials, so this last round places three different bets: (A) many more, smaller policy updates at the maximum sample count, with short-horizon credit; (B) a global-attention trunk over cells, a design not yet tried; (C) a separate critic, so value regression cannot damage the policy features.
